Gradient Text Generator

Make gradient-filled text with background-clip — pick colors and angle, preview live, copy the CSS snippet.

Gradient Text

📖 How to use

  1. Type your text.
  2. Pick two (or three) gradient colors and an angle.
  3. Copy the CSS — it uses background: linear-gradient + background-clip: text.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does gradient text work in CSS?

The gradient is painted as the element background, then background-clip: text with transparent color cuts the background to the glyph shapes.

Does it work in all browsers?

All modern browsers support background-clip: text (with -webkit- prefix for Safari/Chrome). The generated snippet includes both.

Can screen readers read it?

Yes — it is real text, not an image, so assistive tech reads it normally. Keep contrast reasonable for low-vision users.
